entity.name: cpp-linter
entity.description: cpp-linter is a volunteer-run GitHub organization that brings clang-format and clang-tidy into everyday C/C++ development. It maintains a GitHub Action, Python and Rust CLIs, pre-commit hooks, and prebuilt LLVM clang tools for Linux, macOS and Windows. The tools are used by 1,000+ public repositories (including projects from Bloomberg, Qualcomm, Samsung and the Apache Software Foundation), the prebuilt binaries have 715,000+ downloads, and the PyPI packages have 1.3M+ downloads. The organization is maintained by two active maintainers in their spare time.

projects.name: cpp-linter-action
projects.description: A GitHub Action that runs clang-format and clang-tidy on pull requests and reports results as annotations, PR review suggestions, thread comments and step summaries. Used by 1,000+ public repositories.

projects.name: cpp-linter (Python)
projects.description: The Python package behind cpp-linter-action. Runs clang-format and clang-tidy on changed files and posts feedback to pull requests; also usable as a CLI in any CI.

projects.name: cpp-linter-rs
projects.description: A Rust implementation of cpp-linter: a fast, single-binary CLI that runs clang-format and clang-tidy and reports results to pull requests.

projects.name: cpp-linter-hooks
projects.description: pre-commit hooks that run clang-format and clang-tidy locally, installing the requested LLVM version automatically.

projects.name: clang-tools-static-binaries
projects.description: Prebuilt static binaries of clang-format, clang-tidy, clang-query and other LLVM clang tools for Linux, macOS and Windows on amd64 and arm64, for LLVM 12 and newer. 715,000+ downloads.

projects.name: clang-tools (PyPI)
projects.description: A Python installer for the prebuilt clang tools binaries, with checksum verification. Published on PyPI as clang-tools, with 700,000+ downloads.

channels.description: Preferred. Funds are held transparently on Open Collective.
GitHub Sponsors for the cpp-linter organization.

plans.name: Ongoing maintenance
plans.description: Keeping up with every LLVM release across all distribution channels (binaries, PyPI wheels, Docker, Homebrew), triaging issues, reviewing pull requests and covering CI costs.

plans.name: Signed and verifiable clang tools binaries
plans.description: Signed build provenance (Sigstore / GitHub attestations), SBOMs and reproducible builds for every prebuilt clang tools binary, with automatic verification in our installers and the GitHub Action.

plans.name: cpp-linter v2 (Rust) and more CI platforms
plans.description: Ship the Rust implementation as cpp-linter v2 and add support beyond GitHub, such as GitLab merge requests and SARIF output.
